entities.name: Lukáš Ticháček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lukáš Ticháček is a Czech professional volleyball player with Polish citizenship, a former member of the Czech Republic national team. A bronze medalist at the 2013 European League, and the 2006–07 CEV Champions League winner.
